significance_rule: 95% percentile CI of the paired macro-Dice difference excludes zero
interpretation_guard: Phase 21 has NO architecture-matched control (no identical plain model trained under the same Phase-21 run). Therefore the ONLY permitted phrasing is 'Global MedFiLM achieved X compared with baseline Y'. It is FORBIDDEN to claim 'FiLM caused +X'. Where a CI overlaps zero the models are NOT distinguishable.
